description: This bar chart illustrates a comparison of runtime performance for different models in a streaming environment. The horizontal axis displays the model names – “Our joint Framework”, “ChatGPT”, “DeepSeek”, “LLaMA”, and “Claude” – in that order, and is a categorical axis. The vertical axis, labeled “Runtime (seconds)”, represents the runtime values on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 400, with tick marks at 50-second intervals. Two bars are present for each model, colored green for “Our joint Framework” and light blue for “LLM Models”. For “Our joint Framework”, the bars have heights of approximately 77 seconds, 190 seconds, 172 seconds, 243 seconds, and 365 seconds, corresponding to the models “Our joint Framework”, “ChatGPT”, “DeepSeek”, “LLaMA”, and “Claude”, respectively. The “LLM Models” bars have heights of approximately 172 seconds, 243 seconds, 365 seconds, and 190 seconds for “ChatGPT”, “DeepSeek”, “Claude”, and “LLaMA”, respectively. The bars are grouped side-by-side for each model, with the “Our joint Framework” bar appearing to the left of the “LLM Models” bar. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
